items.title: Show HN: Content-adaptive display brightness for macOS with DDC/CI support
items.contentSnippet:
I was always annoyed that I had to adjust brightness when switching from an IDE in dark mode to a bright web page. I was aware of Lumen https://github.com/anishathalye/lumen but didn't use it since it does not support external monitors.
Therefore, I built Lumos, which is heavily inspired by Lumen but adds support for external monitors. The DDC/CI part of the code is vendored from https://github.com/MonitorControl/MonitorControl. It really improved my experience and I almost never have to manuall

items.title: Show HN: Bateri – a terminal, which you can drag&drop files to upload/download
items.contentSnippet:
A friend of mine developed a yet another terminal application for Mac OS X, such that now I can finally:
- Drag & drop files to upload to a remote host,
- Do `ls` then right click to download files.
- Command + T and Command + D: if I am using ssh within the current session, the new terminal opens up within that remote folder.
It'd be good to know your thoughts.

items.contentSnippet:
